node.statement: Coordinate column identity: because Q is one-dimensional in every H-CB datum, the defined level-one sesquilinear form on S_{P,Q} is characterized by Y_i^dagger dot V_i = <Y_i,V_i>*u_Q for every coordinate i; this is part of the corresponding defined sesquilinear forms included by def-hcb-datum.
